subject: Quality checks before furniture leaves the workshop
hook: Last 30 seconds before a trade order leaves the workshop.
ig:
Last 30 seconds before a trade order leaves the workshop.

This is the bit nobody films: the checks between machining and collection.

Measured against the cutting list, not the next panel.
Diagonals measured to confirm it's square.
A hand along every banded edge for lift or overhang.
Hole positions checked against the drawing.
Faces tilted to the light to spot marks.
Labelled to your list, stacked and wrapped.

It takes minutes per order and saves hours on site when a part doesn't fit.

If you're a fitter or joiner who'd rather spend site time building than fixing, comment PANELS and we'll send the trade services link.
fb:
We don't often show this part, but it's the bit that matters most to our trade customers: the checks before an order goes out.

Measured against your cutting list, squared by the diagonals, edging checked by hand, drilling checked against the drawing, faces inspected, then labelled and wrapped.

Panel cutting, edging, drilling and assembly for fitters, joiners and installers. Have a look at our trade services.

alt: Video: measuring a cut panel, checking diagonals, running a hand along edging, checking a hinge hole, inspecting a face and wrapping labelled panels.
on_asset:
Cover: Checked before it leaves |
SC1 (0–2s) visual: tape measure snapped across a freshly cut panel / on-screen: Checked against your list |
SC2 (2–6s) visual: tape across both diagonals of a panel / on-screen: Diagonals match = square |
SC3 (6–11s) visual: hand running along an edge-banded edge, close-up of trimmed corner / on-screen: Edging bonded and trimmed |
SC4 (11–16s) visual: pin gauge or rule checking a hinge cup position against a drawing / on-screen: Holes where the drawing says |
SC5 (16–21s) visual: panel tilted to the light to inspect the face / on-screen: Faces checked for marks |
SC6 (21–27s) visual: label applied, panels stacked and wrapped / on-screen: Labelled, wrapped, ready to collect
